name: title
description: Short label naming a method record.

aiGuidance.purpose: The 3-8 word noun phrase a reader scans in a list to tell this record from its siblings.
aiGuidance.extraction: Compress the record's own subject; drop leading articles and verbs of intent. Distinct from sibling titles.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Never a truncated statement, an id such as SP-12, or a generic phrase. Never overwrite a title a person set.
